newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes steady against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed mostly steady at 42.5225/5325 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous close at 42.5250/5300, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted weaker at 42.5200/5400 per dollar in early trade but deals were mostly at around 42.5300 level.

"Dollar demand was comparatively higher today. Some private banks bought actively for import payments. Yet the taka recovered early losses as supply (of dollar) continues to outweigh demand," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates finished at 6.5 to 7.5 percent, up from Sunday's 6.0-6.5 percent.
